item.title: 2026 Hyundai Exter Facelift: Refreshed Look, Enhanced Features, and Safety Upgrades Coming Soon in India
item.description: Hyundai is set to launch the 2026 Exter Facelift in India with a refreshed exterior, upgraded infotainment, enhanced safety features, and possible turbo-petrol variant. Starting around ₹6 lakh, it aims to rival Tata Punch and Nissan Magnite.

item.title: Tamil Nadu SIR Row: SC cracks down, orders voter lists to be displayed at Panchayat and ward offices
item.description: A Bench headed by Chief Justice Surya Kant directed the ECI to publicly display the list of voters placed under the “Logical Discrepancy” category at Gram Panchayat offices, taluka (sub-division) offices, and urban ward offices across the state.

item.title: Tamil Nadu SIR: Supreme Court directs publication of names in ‘logical discrepancy’ voter lists; Details inside
item.description: The Supreme Court orders the Election Commission to publish names in Tamil Nadu’s ‘logical discrepancy’ voter lists, giving citizens 10 days to correct errors raising questions about how many eligible voters could be affected.

item.title: Indian Stock Market Rallies Amid Volatility; Sensex Surges Over 900 Points from Intraday Lows
item.description: Indian stock markets saw a volatile session on 29th January, with Sensex and Nifty recovering strongly from intraday lows. Metals and private banks led gains, supported by FII-DII buying and optimism over global trade deals.

item.title: ‘Our Daughters Can Hit Every Boundary’: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta honours World Champion Blind Women’s T20 Team
item.description: Interacting with the cricketers, the Chief Minister praised their resilience, courage, and fighting spirit. “The daughters of our nation are extremely strong. I firmly believe they have the power to hit the ball out of the park, no matter the challenges they face,” she said, calling the team an inspiration for the entire country.

item.title: ‘I Didn’t Feel Respected’: Yuvraj Singh opens up on why he retired from international cricket
item.description: Yuvraj Singh opens up on why he retired from international cricket in 2019, citing lack of respect and support after surviving cancer. The former India star reveals the mental and emotional toll that ended his 18-year cricketing journey.

item.title: India remain fastest growing economy for 4th consecutive year; pegged economic (GDP) growth at 7.4% in FY26
item.description: The Economic Survey 2025–26 highlights India’s continued position as the fastest-growing major economy, driven by strong domestic demand, resilient agriculture, robust manufacturing, controlled inflation, and stable external finances, supporting the vision of achieving Viksit Bharat by 2047.

item.title: Agriculture to drive Viksit Bharat, inclusive growth and rural prosperity: Economic survey
item.description: The Survey underlines that agriculture will be central to achieving the vision of Viksit Bharat, ensuring inclusive growth and improving the livelihoods of millions.

item.title: CJI Flags Risk of Social Division as Supreme Court Questions UGC’s New Anti-Discrimination Rules
item.description: The Supreme Court raised serious concerns over UGC’s new anti-discrimination rules, questioning caste-specific provisions, the idea of separate hostels, and the exclusion of ragging, while stressing the need for inclusive, equality-based regulations aligned with the Constitution.

item.title: Beating Retreat: President Murmu, PM Modi attend event to mark end of 77th Republic Day celebrations
item.description: As central Delhi lit up and military bands marched in perfect sync, the Beating Retreat ceremony marked the quiet yet powerful end of India’s 77th Republic Day celebrations, with the President and Prime Minister in attendance at Vijay Chowk.
